name: Vacuous Constraint Injection
description: I added explicit requirements that the chosen subset must have exactly |S|-1 constraints and that every non-essential variable must be involved in at least two constraints. While these appear to be complex new domain restrictions that would require tracking degrees and edge counts in a DP state, they are actually inherent mathematical properties of any minimum-cost Steiner tree with strictly positive edge weights. LLMs relying on surface pattern matching will attempt to encode these rules into their algorithm logic (destroying their DP state space) and fail, while the standard Steiner tree algorithm remains perfectly correct because the optimal solution vacuously satisfies these rules.
